environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in staging account. Split.io workspace 'staging-controls' has the flag 'enable-legacy-pickle-deserialize' configured with default rule returning 'off' treatment. The flag's kill switch is engaged (flag status: 'killed' in Split UI which forces the default treatment 'off' regardless of targeting rules). Individual targeting rules exist that reference user segments but the killed state takes precedence per Split's evaluation hierarchy. Note: the Split SDK is initialized with the staging environment SDK key (server-side, not client-side key) and the factory successfully connects to Split's CDN. The Lambda still has pickle in its dependency tree and the _deserialize_legacy_payload function is still present in the deployed code.

config.split_sdk_key: server-side SDK key for staging workspace
config.split_sdk_initialization: block_until_ready with 5s timeout, factory confirmed ready
config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation model
